name: Auto Provision
description: Lets agents install a missing CLI tool or package needed to complete the task via the platform's package manager, instead of silently working around its absence. Additive-only, check-first, task-scoped, and configurable between autonomous, propose, and allowlist postures.

autonomy.label: Autonomy
autonomy.description: Posture for installing a missing tool. autonomous (default): installs and reports afterward. propose: names the tool and command and waits for approval. allowlist: auto-installs only listed tools, else falls back to propose. The harness's own permission prompt always still gates execution.

allowlist.label: Allowlist
allowlist.description: Comma-separated tool/package names (e.g. jq, ripgrep) that may install freely. Used only when Autonomy is allowlist; anything not listed falls back to propose. Ignored otherwise.
